title: Excellent
text:
A simply extraordinary and unforgettable experience!
Today we had the pleasure of enjoying a fabulous experience at the hands of Juve, an exceptional tour guide who turned our visit into a truly enriching, fascinating moment full of memorable memories.
Her professionalism, passion, and deep knowledge of history were evident in every explanation. She knew how to convey with enthusiasm and elegance all the details, curiosities, and historical events, paying special attention to every corner, to the majestic Palace of Charles V, and to all those small details that often go unnoticed by the visito
